description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Explain ANY EventTrader event card by its title, EVCDX-* ticker, or id. Returns the title, summary, full basket (assets + weights), live index vs base (% since inception), status, the EVCDX-* token + contract, resolution source, and URL. Read-only. NEVER fabricate a card's basket members or index value.

query.description: Event-card title (or partial), EVCDX-* ticker, or card id.

name: get_event_card_info
title: Get Event Card Info
